title: R5B E2A 12FP COLD T5 KITTING CONTROL  ·  WK 40
plan: R5B 4FP POB LUMENTUM SUB ASSEMBLY - E2A
howto: Go to 'Work Orders'. Type the WO number in column A and pick the assy code in column B. Description, sequence and quantity fill in by themselves.

WO Qty = the listed qty from the kitting plan (e.g. 24 for 92RRA00548AAA, 2 for 92YLS00548BBA). Pick the repeater (1–13) the WO belongs to, or leave it blank for the repeater being released. Type in 'Qty Override' only if the WO is for a different quantity.
Change 'Status' as the WO moves: Planned → Released → Kitted → Closed. Blank counts as Planned.
WO No. = WO-4012871 · Assy Code = 92YLS00548BAA · Repeater = 5 · Qty Override = (blank) · Status = Released
Column L on 'Work Orders' warns about duplicate WO numbers, missing codes or codes not in the plan.
Shows the whole plan on one screen: totals at the top, coverage by sequence, the WO pipeline, and every assembly with its WOs.
NO WO = nothing raised yet · SHORT n = WOs cover less than required (n units missing) · COVERED = WO qty matches · OVER = more WO qty than required.
The 'Work Order Nos.' column lists every WO on each assy code. To go the other way, filter column A on 'Work Orders'.

Pick All or a repeater number 1–13 in the pink cell at the top right of the Dashboard. 'All' checks every WO against the release qty; a number shows only that repeater's WOs (plus WOs left blank/All).
Open the Dashboard tab and press Ctrl+F1 to hide the ribbon. The dashboard fits one landscape screen; adjust zoom to your projector if needed. Excel recalculates as soon as anyone adds a WO.
Save the file on SharePoint / OneDrive / Teams so several people can edit while the dashboard is on screen.
Edit the blue cells on 'Kitting Plan' (codes, release qty, default qty). The Dashboard and WO lookups follow automatically.
